title: Generalized Uncertainty Relations and Quantum Speed Limits
summary: We propose a mathematically rigorous unified framework for hybrid quantum mechanics that systematically combines algebraic deformation and spatial non-locality within a single operator formalism. By constructing a self-adjoint hybrid kinetic operator through spectral calculus, we derive exact generalized uncertainty relations that interpolate between $q$-deformed and fractional quantum mechanical bounds.
